custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, and an active part, part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 3.5 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839455-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839455-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Active" is blue.
  • Part B is listed and part A is not.

Step 2:

  • "Inactive" is blue and "Active" is dark text.
  • Part A is listed and part B is not.
  • Part A's row carries no tag or badge: it reads like any row on the Active tab, with the same columns in the same order.
  • The toolbar shows the same controls in the same places as on the Active tab.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S1-R4: “The Inactive tab lists only parts that are inactive at the current location.”
  • S1-R7: “Search, filters and sort work the same way on both tabs.”
  • Story 9, context note: “Context note: the Inactive tab (Story 1) is what tells active and inactive parts apart on the Inventory list. If an "All" option is ever added (PRD 462, FR-012), a per-row badge becomes necessary.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
